observations.behavior: Adds a helper function `_is_stale_connection_read_only_error` to detect read-only transaction errors, and updates the docstrings of `aretry_on_db_connection_drop` and `retry_on_db_connection_drop` to document the new error handling. observations.posthog_connection: This could help PostHog handle database connection failures more robustly, especially in the context of database failovers and pool recycling.
